name: cook-it
description: Import recipes, cook step by step, scale servings, and export to Markdown.

interface.longDescription: Upload or paste a recipe, organize it with the Cook-It template, adjust servings, and cook one step at a time. Export a Markdown recipe to keep wherever you like. With write access to Google Drive, Cook-It saves recipes there by default. Markdown export is always an option.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through making tortilla de patatas for four, one step at a time.
I have eggs, potatoes and onions. What can I cook?
Organize my uploaded recipe, scale it to six servings, and export it as Markdown.
